summaryEn: Tesla's official 2023 annual shareholder meeting with Musk's company update on the drivetrain, FSD and Cybertruck.
summaryZh: Tesla 官方举行的 2023 年度股东大会，马斯克介绍了公司在动力总成、FSD 和 Cybertruck 方面的最新情况。

segments.textEn: Good afternoon, everyone.
segments.textZh: 大家下午好。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: Good afternoon everyone, and welcome to Tesla's 2023 annual shareholder meeting in Austin, Texas.
segments.textZh: 大家下午好，欢迎来到得克萨斯州奥斯汀参加 Tesla 2023 年度股东大会。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: My name is Martin Vieja, I'm vice President of Investor relations and I will be the chair of today's meeting. First of all, I really wanted to thank everyone who continues to do this trip on annual basis and shows up every time. It's really quite something that we have a following as dedicated as this, so thank you very much for that.
segments.textZh: 我叫马丁·维耶哈，是投资者关系副总裁，我将担任今天会议的主席。首先，我真的想感谢所有每年都继续踏上这段旅程、每次都会到场的人。我们拥有如此投入的一群追随者，这真的很了不起，所以非常感谢大家。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: I also wanted to thank our first time visitors. I know that many of you won a lottery to come for the first time to a festival shareholder meeting.
segments.textZh: 我也想感谢第一次来访的各位。我知道你们当中很多人抽中了签，得以第一次前来参加一场节庆股东大会。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: You'll probably notice that unlike many other shareholder meetings of other companies, this one tends to be a bit more fun. So hope you enjoy that. But the last thing I really wanted to say is that just thank you so much for all your support over the years. We really feel like you're part of our mission, you know, part of our, you know, story, and it's something we truly, truly value. So thank you so much for that.
segments.textZh: 你们可能会注意到，与许多其他公司的股东大会不同，这场大会往往会更有趣一些。所以希望你们享受其中。但我真正想说的最后一件事，就是非常感谢大家多年来给予的所有支持。我们真的觉得你们是我们使命的一部分，你知道，是我们的，你知道，故事的一部分，而这是我们真正、真正珍视的。所以非常感谢大家。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: There will be two parts of today's meeting. First, the formal part of the meeting where we will cover items that stockholders have been asked to vote on, as well as any other matters that are properly presented. And after the voting, I will introduce Tesla's co founder and CEO and technoking Elon Musk, who will give a presentation about Tesla's year in review. But at this time, I'd like to thank the members of the Tesla team and the board who are here with us here today.
segments.textZh: 今天的会议将分为两个部分。首先是会议的正式部分，我们将讨论已请股东投票表决的事项，以及任何其他得到适当提出的事务。投票结束后，我将介绍 Tesla 的联合创始人、首席执行官兼技术之王埃隆·马斯克，他将就 Tesla 的年度回顾进行演讲。但现在，我想感谢今天来到这里与我们共聚一堂的 Tesla 团队成员和董事会成员。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: Representative from PricewaterhouseCoopers, Tesla's independent auditor, present with us as well. But before we begin, I'd like to introduce you to Tesla's chair, Robin Denholm, who would like to say a few words.
segments.textZh: Tesla 的独立审计机构普华永道的代表也与我们一同在场。但在开始之前，我想向大家介绍 Tesla 董事长罗宾·德诺姆，她想讲几句话。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: I'm a little bit shorter, so. Hello everyone.
segments.textZh: 我个子矮一点，所以。大家好。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: On behalf of the board, I am really honored to welcome you all here today to the 2023 Annual Shareholder Meeting. It's wonderful for me to see everyone in the room today and also the many investors that have joined us today via the virtual livestream. It's our third straight year of having the annual meeting here in Austin. At the first meeting, the factory was still in the early stages of development, with equipment being installed and commissioned.
segments.textZh: 我谨代表董事会，非常荣幸地欢迎大家今天来到这里参加 2023 年度股东大会。今天能见到会场里的每一个人，以及通过线上直播加入我们的众多投资者，我感到非常高兴。这是我们连续第 3 年在奥斯汀举行年度会议。第一次开会时，工厂仍处于开发初期，设备正在安装和调试。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: During the 2022 meeting, production had started to ramp as we produced about 1600 vehicles that week. And now, less than a year later, we have more than tripled the amount, having achieved production of 5,000 cars in a single week.
segments.textZh: 在 2022 年会议期间，产量已经开始提升，我们那一周生产了约 1600 辆汽车。而现在，不到 1 年后，我们已经将这一数字提高到 3 倍以上，实现了单周生产 5,000 辆汽车。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: A huge concept. Congratulations to the Texas team. And on top of that, we are getting ready to Roll out our first cybertrucks.
segments.textZh: 一个巨大的概念。祝贺得克萨斯团队。除此之外，我们正准备推出首批 Cybertruck。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: This exponential trajectory of the gigafactory here in Texas is a reflection of Tesla as a whole.
segments.textZh: 得克萨斯州这座超级工厂的指数级发展轨迹正是 Tesla 整体状况的写照。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: In 2022 was another record breaking year for us with deliveries and growing by 40% year over year. And that trend has continued in the first quarter of 2023. We would not be able to achieve this growth without the dedication of our amazing employees. I've been fortunate enough over the years to actually travel to many of our locations, all of the gigafactories around the world. And, and I can tell you that I've witnessed firsthand how our exceptional employees in our global talent across the world has together achieved our mission or furthered our mission of accelerating the world's transition to sustainable energy.
segments.textZh: 2022 年对我们来说又是一个打破纪录的年份，交付量同比增长 40%。这一趋势在 2023 年第一季度延续了下来。如果没有我们出色员工的投入，我们不可能实现这样的增长。这些年来，我非常有幸实际走访了我们的许多地点，包括世界各地的所有超级工厂。而且，而且我可以告诉大家，我亲眼见证了我们遍布全球的优秀员工和全球人才如何共同实现了我们的使命，或者说进一步推进了我们加速世界向可持续能源转型的使命。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Huge round of applause please.
segments.textZh: 请大家热烈鼓掌。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: This year here in Texas, we also had our very first investor day where we introduced our company leaders from design to engineering, to supply chain, manufacturing, energy and charging. And they each spoke about the role of their teams in making our mission come to life. And I was thrilled that investors were able to hear directly from this outstanding leadership team that Elon has been able to put together over many, many years.
segments.textZh: 今年，我们还在得克萨斯州举行了首次投资者日，介绍了公司从设计、工程到供应链、制造、能源和充电各领域的领导者。他们分别讲述了各自团队在让我们的使命成为现实方面所发挥的作用。投资者能够直接听到这支由埃隆历经很多、很多年组建起来的杰出领导团队发言，我感到非常激动。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: It is on the strength of their leadership and the hard work of our dedicated employees around the world that I believe we are not only weather the macroeconomic environment that we've seen this year, but also continue to be in the strongest position ever to advance Tesla's mission. As a startup. Tesla proved that electric vehicles could be fun with the Roadster. They could even be better than gas powered vehicles in every single way with the S and X and could be all of these things as well as affordable with the Model 3 and Model Y which last quarter became the best selling vehicle of any kind in Europe and the best selling non pickup vehicle in the United States.
segments.textZh: 正是凭借他们强有力的领导，以及我们世界各地尽职员工的辛勤工作，我相信我们不仅经受住我们今年所见的宏观经济环境，而且还继续处于有史以来推进 Tesla 使命的最有利位置。作为一家初创企业。Tesla 用 Roadster 证明了电动汽车可以充满乐趣。凭借 S 和 X，它们甚至可以在每一个方面都胜过燃油汽车；而凭借 Model 3 和 Model Y，它们不仅可以具备这一切，也可以负担得起。Model 3 和 Model Y 上季度成为欧洲所有类别中最畅销的汽车，以及美国最畅销的非皮卡汽车。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: And today, as one of the world's largest global companies, we plan to change the paradigm again by forging the path to achieving a global sustainable energy economy as set out at our investor day in our master plan.
segments.textZh: 而今天，作为全球规模最大的公司之一，我们计划再次改变范式，按照投资者日上在我们的宏图计划中所阐述的那样，开辟一条实现全球可持续能源经济的道路。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: As Tesla grows, so do our customers positive impact on carbon emissions. When I stood here last year, I proudly announced that in 2021, our customers avoided emitting 8.4 million metric tons of greenhouse gas emissions, the equivalent of over 20 billion miles driven by internal combustion engine vehicles. Today I can tell you that in 2022, our customers avoided releasing over 13.4 million metric tonnes of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
segments.textZh: 随着 Tesla 的发展，我们的客户对碳排放产生的积极影响也在增长。去年我站在这里时，自豪地宣布，2021 年，我们的客户避免了 840 万公吨的温室气体排放，相当于内燃机汽车行驶超过 200 亿英里产生的排放。今天我可以告诉大家，2022 年，我们的客户避免了向大气中排放超过 1340 万公吨的温室气体。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: The equivalent of over 33 billion miles of driving of internal combustion vehicles.
segments.textZh: 相当于内燃机汽车行驶超过 330 亿英里。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: That that's an almost 60% increase in total emission savings year over year. Putting more of our products in customers hands helps grow that number and our goals of making our products greener over time and further decarbonizing the electric grid will help multiply that effect. As part of that goal, I am delighted to say that as described in our recent impact report, our global supercharging Network was again 100% renewable in 2022.
segments.textZh: 那那相当于避免的排放总量同比增长近 60%。让更多产品进入客户手中有助于提高这一数字，而我们让产品逐渐变得更加环保并进一步推动电网脱碳的目标，将有助于成倍放大这种效果。作为这一目标的一部分，我很高兴地宣布，正如我们最近的影响力报告所述，2022 年，我们的全球超级充电网络再次实现 100% 使用可再生能源。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: We've been able to achieve all of this while maintaining. Sorry, maintaining industry margins, industry leading margins and generating strong cash flows over the last several years. Going forward, we will continue our focus on capital investment plans to support our future growth with investments in batteries, in vehicle production, including the next generation platform, in the building of our lithium refinery that we recently broke ground on, in the energy storage factories, in our sales and service footprint and in our charging network, among other things.
segments.textZh: 我们在实现这一切的同时，也一直保持着。抱歉，保持着行业利润率、行业领先的利润率，并在过去几年中产生了强劲的现金流。展望未来，我们将继续专注于资本投资计划，通过对电池、车辆生产（包括下一代平台）、我们最近破土动工的锂精炼厂建设、储能工厂、销售和服务网络以及充电网络等方面的投资，为未来增长提供支持。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Before I hand it back to Martin, I would also like to thank Hiro Mizuno for his dedicated service to the Tesla shareholders and the Board these past three years. I would also like to express our enthusiasm on behalf of my fellow directors at the prospect of JB Straubal joining our Board.
segments.textZh: 在把话筒交还给马丁之前，我还想感谢水野弘道过去 3 年来为 Tesla 股东和董事会所做的尽职服务。我也想代表董事会同仁，对 JB·斯特劳巴尔可能加入我们的董事会表达热切期待。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: I don't have to tell you that his passion for Tesla and green tech will make him an important asset in our mission to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy. So again, on behalf of our full Board, thank you for your tremendous support and welcome to your 2023 shareholder meeting. And with that, I'll hand it back to Mart.
segments.textZh: 无需我来告诉大家，他对 Tesla 和绿色科技的热情将使他成为我们加速世界向可持续能源转型这一使命中的重要资产。因此，我再次代表全体董事会，感谢大家给予的巨大支持，并欢迎各位参加你们的 2023 年股东大会。接下来，我把话筒交还给马特。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Thank you Robin.
segments.textZh: 谢谢你，罗宾。
segments.speakerZh: 马丁·维耶查（投资者关系）

segments.textEn: I will now call the meeting to order. Please refer to the meeting agenda that has been provided to you and post it on the virtual meeting site. The time is now 3:10pm Central Time and I declare the polls are now open.
segments.textZh: 我现在宣布会议开始。请参阅已提供给各位的会议议程，并将其发布在虚拟会议网站上。现在是美国中部时间下午 3:10，我宣布投票现已开始。

segments.textEn: We have already received over the last few weeks voting proxies from stockholders, meaning that almost all the votes that will be counted were already submitted before today. However, if you wish to vote your shares or change your prior vote, you may do so through the virtual meeting site. For those who are in person here today, ballots and ballot boxes were available to you at the check in Tesla's Board of Directors has appointed Computer Share Trust Company to serve to serve as Inspector of Elections.
segments.textZh: 在过去几周里，我们已经收到了股东提交的委托投票，这意味着几乎所有将被计入的投票都已在今天之前提交。不过，如果您希望就所持股份投票或更改此前的投票，可以通过虚拟会议网站进行操作。对于今天亲临现场的各位，签到处已备有选票和投票箱，Tesla 董事会已任命 Computer Share Trust Company 担任、担任选举监察员。

segments.textEn: Computershare has taken and signed an oath as Inspector and has certified that starting on April 6, 2023, the proxy materials or a notice of Internet availability of proxy materials were mailed or provided to all Tesla Stockholders of record. March 20, 2023.
segments.textZh: Computershare 已作为监察员宣誓并签字，并已证明，自 2023 年 4 月 6 日起，委托书材料或委托书材料互联网可用性通知已邮寄或提供给所有在册 Tesla 股东。2023 年 3 月 20 日。

segments.textEn: We have majority of outstanding chairs represented at the meeting, so I declare that there's a quorum present at the meeting and we may proceed with the meeting. The items on the agenda are as follows. Number one. The election of Class 1 directors Elon Musk, Robin Denholm and JB Straubel to serve for a term of three years or until the respective successors are duly elected and qualified. Number two. To approve executive compensation on a non binding advisory basis.
segments.textZh: 出席会议的流通在外椅子已占多数，因此我宣布本次会议达到法定人数，我们可以继续开会。议程事项如下。第 1 项。选举第 1 类董事埃隆·马斯克、罗宾·德诺姆和 JB·施特劳贝尔，任期为 3 年，或直至各自的继任者得到正式选举并具备任职资格。第 2 项。以不具约束力的咨询方式批准高管薪酬。

segments.textEn: Number three. To approve the frequency of future votes on executive compensation on a non binding advisory basis. Number four. To ratify the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as Tesla's independent public registered accounting firm for the 2023 fiscal year. Number five. To vote on a stockholder proposal included in our proxy statement which relates to the reporting of key person risk. Number six. To vote on a stockholder proposal which the stockholders did not seek to have included in our proxy statement.
segments.textZh: 第 3 项。以不具约束力的咨询方式批准未来就高管薪酬进行投票的频率。第 4 项。批准任命 PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP 为 Tesla 2023 财年的独立注册公共会计师事务所。第 5 项。就我们委托书中所载的一项股东提案进行投票，该提案涉及关键人物风险报告。第 6 项。就一项股东并未寻求纳入我们委托书的股东提案进行投票。

segments.textEn: Tesla's board has recommended that our stockholders vote for each of the director nominees for the approval by non binding advisory board of executive compensation and the ratification of appointment of PwC as an independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2023 and every three years for non binding advisory vote for the frequency of future votes on executive compensation with respect to stockholder proposal included in our proxy statement which relates to the reporting on the key man risk.
segments.textZh: Tesla董事会已建议我们的股东投票支持每一位董事候选人，批准关于高管薪酬的不具约束力的咨询表决，批准任命普华永道为2023财年的独立注册公共会计师事务所，并就未来高管薪酬表决的频率每3年进行一次不具约束力的咨询表决；关于纳入我们委托书、涉及关键人物风险报告的股东提案。

segments.textEn: Karen Roberts Doughertier on behalf of Sumtris, is here to present this proposal. Ms. Roberts Doughertier, can you please identify yourself?
segments.textZh: 凯伦·罗伯茨·多尔蒂尔代表Sumtris到场介绍这项提案。罗伯茨·多尔蒂尔女士，能请您说明自己的身份吗？

segments.textEn: I would like to invite you to speak. You will have three minutes.
segments.textZh: 我想邀请您发言。您将有3分钟时间。

segments.textEn: Hello. Thank you for having me here today. Under discussion is a shareholder proposal concerning key person risk at Tesla requiring Tesla's board to draft a report covering the steps taken to ameliorate the potential impacts of loss of key persons in the company. However, before I begin, I would first like to say thank you to Mr. Musk. For so many of us, you stepped into fields where we had so desperately wanted to see change.
segments.textZh: 大家好。感谢各位邀请我今天来到这里。现在讨论的是一项有关Tesla关键人物风险的股东提案，要求Tesla董事会起草一份报告，涵盖为减轻公司关键人物流失的潜在影响而采取的措施。不过，在开始之前，我首先想对马斯克先生表示感谢。对我们许多人来说，您踏入了那些我们一直迫切希望看到改变的领域。

segments.textEn: And through bringing in a talented team willing to put in long hours, you dragged reluctant industries kicking and screaming into a better future. And for that, thank you. Building up this juggernaut around us which, as you largely put it, runs itself these days.
segments.textZh: 通过引进一支愿意长时间工作的优秀团队，你把那些不情愿的行业连踢带拽、又喊又叫地拖进了一个更美好的未来。为此，谢谢你。你在我们周围打造起了这台巨无霸，正如你大体上所说，它如今可以自行运转。

segments.textEn: Thank you for that. And yet now, here we are today, at a time when Tesla's technological leadership should be on display the investment community largely sees as adrift with management focused on all the matters, not Tesla. Watching as Tesla's brand favorability dropped by 15 points last year. Something that costs us margins. We have such a spectacular product pipeline and a team that knows how to execute at scale with low cost of goods sold.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。可是现在，今天，我们却处在这样一个时刻：Tesla 的技术领导地位本应得到彰显，但投资界普遍认为公司正随波漂流，管理层专注于所有其他事务，而不是 Tesla。眼看着 Tesla 的品牌好感度去年下降了 15 个百分点。这件事让我们付出了利润率方面的代价。我们拥有如此出色的产品管线，还有一支懂得如何以低销货成本进行规模化执行的团队。

segments.textEn: Something that we are not being properly Recognized for it should go without saying, but apparently bears repeating, that if you cannot produce with low cogs, you have no future. When I look around the auto industry these days, I see a lot of companies that have no future. And that's a success on behalf of an incredible team here at Tesla that deserves recognition. When people look at this company, that's not what they see.
